title: Hillary Clinton tells Kimmel she'll get to the bottom of UFOs

tellings.quote: and and and then he asked her the question and that's when she says, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this."

plain: During her 2016 run for president, the politician Hillary Clinton was asked about UFOs by the late-night talk show host Jimmy Kimmel on his Los Angeles show, and she answered, "I'm going to get to the bottom of this." The UFO researcher Grant Cameron recounts the moment from memory on the show, without naming a source. He tells it as a sign that a leading candidate was ready to look into the subject in public.
